title: Songs by ear, numbered tunes, and credit owed to songwriters
summary: How songs spread by ear in old days, and his complaint that jazz musicians do not credit the songwriters they rely on.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
